title: atip/1 --input document (generic fragment shape)
description: What every --input value parses to (spec 11.4-11.6): one document, or, where the command declares `input.batch`, a non-empty array of documents. This is the shape all fragment schemas share; each command publishes its exact fragment schema at input.schemaRef. Requirements are checked after the merge with argv (spec 11.7), not here.

propertyNames.description: camelCase option names, plus `operands`. The four reserved flag-only options never appear.

operands.description: The operands in order; omit the key when there are none.

additionalProperties.description: A switch is a boolean, a count a non-negative integer, a valued option its value, a repeatable option an array of values, a json option any JSON value but null. This generic shape refuses a top-level null; the command's fragment schema refuses the rest (nulls inside a repeatable option's array, wrong types).

argumentValue.description: One argument value: a string, a number, a boolean, an object or an array (spec 10.7.2, 11.5). Never null at this level; nulls nested inside a json value belong to that value.
